//AllowedHosts: In production set this to your real hostnames, e.g. 'ficipedia.com;www.ficipedia.com'. Leaving it '*' lets a spoofed Host header be reflected into canonical tags and absolute URLs.

Site.//BaseUrl: Canonical public address, used for sitemap.xml and robots.txt. Leave empty to derive it from the request (fine locally, spoofable in production).

Admin.//SyncKey: Leave empty to disable /admin/sync-subscriptions. When set, pass it in the X-Admin-Sync-Key header. Clear it again once the backfill has run.
